form as in its early phases appears either to have severely degraded or to have been replaced by something vastly inferior it does not make much sense it is as if someone wrote a story about evolution and mixed up the chapters either that or et has sent most of its fleet back home as someone who was an official investigator during what i consider some of the best years for ufo evidence i have noticed an almost total lack of compelling contemporary evidence for the reality of flying saucers over the last few decades this stands in stark contrast to the earlier years especially the first half of the halfcentury following the 1947 wave apparently the genuine component of the ufo phenomenon has gone covert taking with it the more dramatic flying saucer reports i believe this is the principal reason it is harder to defend ufology today the contemporary evidence is far less compelling for the record this is my case for flying saucers before getting into that however a few things need to be made clear the subject of ufos and flying saucers becomes far more difficult to accept when the wrong evidence is examined skeptics and nonbelievers consistently select reports from the identified or ifo category cases that even we do not pay much attention to when that approach fails they generally attempt to rewrite history by altering the facts surrounding the strongest cases it has not worked but attention is still being diverted away from what we actually do know what constitutes a good ufo report personally i would never have become involved in the ufo controversy if i had been dealing only with civilian sightings in the early years before the increase in close approaches and close encounters reported by civilians most civilian reports consisted of what we now call nocturnal lights and distant objects observed all over the world what truly captured my attention were the more detailed closerange military encounters particularly pilot reports and radar tracking after the robertson panel in 1953 established new rules for how the air force would handle ufo investigations a systematic debunking campaign drew serious attention away from the subject at least in the eyes of the media and the public press releases throughout the late 1950s and early 1960s repeatedly claimed that the air force had no evidence suggesting that ufos might actually exist by the 1980s dr david saunders and cufos had compiled over 106000 sightings in the ufocat computer database included in this collection were some of the best ufo reports ever filed to date the database contains more than 3000 sightings from aircraft 6 or 185 cases involving em effects 489 radar cases 21 of which are radarvisuals 5600 physical trace cases with at least 4104 involving actual ufo sightings 441 cases of vehicle interference or em cases from the very beginning descriptions of the real objects were remarkably consistent both military personnel and civilians reported daylight observations of flying saucers later ceii cases in which objects left physical evidence of their presence on the ground often supported the existence of circular objects roughly 30 feet or more in diameter coincidence or not the project sign report postulated a 30foot disc and many reports described discs approximating that size to understand how this picture developed it is necessary to return to the beginning on september 23 1947 after the massive wave of sightings that year including the famous roswell incident general nathan twining sent a letter to the commanding general of the army air forces stating that the reported phenomena were real the first public indication of this came in 1956 when captain edward j ruppelt former director of project blue book discussed it in his book the report on unidentified flying objects later the complete document was found stating it is the opinion that a the phenomenon reported is something real and not visionary or fictitious b there are objects probably approximating the shape of a disc of appreciable size appearing to be as large as manmade aircraft c there is a possibility that some of the incidents may be caused by natural phenomena such as meteors d the reported operating characteristics such as extreme rates of climb maneuverability particularly in a roll and actions that must be considered evasive when sighted or contacted by friendly aircraft and radar lend belief to the possibility that some of the objects are controlled either manually automatically or remotely e the apparent common description of the objects is as follows 1 metallic or lightreflecting surface 2 absence of a trail except in a few instances when the object was apparently operating under highperformance conditions 3 circular or elliptical in shape flat on the bottom and domed on top this document makes it clear that the army air forces were receiving reports of flying saucers and were taking them seriously these were military reports some of them occurring during one of the most intense sighting waves in ufo history the 1947 wave during this sixweek period from late may to early july there were numerous observations of flying discs often over sensitive areas and frequently in broad daylight the intense wave ended abruptly with the reported crash of a flying saucer near roswell new mexico once the crashed saucer was explained as a weather balloon media and public reporting largely ceased but ufo encounters within the military continued in february 1949 the project sign report page 19 summarized what the air force had determined from ufo reports up to that time organizing them into several categories group 1 the most numerous reports involved daytime observations of metallic disclike objects with a diameter roughly ten times their thickness there was some indication that the cross section was asymmetrical resembling a turtle shell reports agreed that these objects were capable of high acceleration and velocity they were often sighted in groups sometimes flying in formation and were occasionally described as fluttering group 2 the second group consisted of reports of lights observed at night these objects were also capable of high speed and acceleration were less commonly seen in groups and usually appeared as sharply defined luminous objects group 3 the third group included reports of various types of rockets generally resembling v2 rockets group 4 the fourth group contained reports of devices that in the opinion of the reports author were sounding balloons of unusual shapes such as those manufactured by the general mills company under navy contract group 5 the fifth group consisted of reports to which little credence could be assigned there were several other reports and studies that mentioned flying saucers but they need not be discussed here suffice it to say flying saucers were taken at face value from the very beginning the question quickly became who did they belong to once foreign powers were ruled out the lid came down in 1960 i was appointed subcommittee chairman for the national investigations committee on aerial phenomena my sevenman investigation unit in southwestern indiana later in 1968 became a rapid response team assigned by nicap to the university of colorado ufo project in 1964 nicap released a document titled the ufo evidence which summarized known patterns of appearance and behavior based on cases they studied through 1963 regarding appearance the most common type was a disc shape followed by spherical ovalelliptical cylindrical and triangular discs were observed in 26 of the cases with a considerable balance very possibly describing a disc viewed from various angles round elliptical cylindrical 283 these discs were not simply drifting aimlessly as noted in the september 23 1947 letter the reported operating characteristics such as extreme rates of climb maneuverability particularly in a roll and action which must be considered evasive when sighted or contacted by friendly aircraft and radar lend belief to the possibility that some of the objects are controlled either manually automatically or remotely here were reports of flying saucers that were not merely airborne but were clearly regarded as highperformance vehicles another characteristic repeatedly noted was the absence of a trail except in a few instances when the object apparently was operating under high performance conditions many people have seen world war ii footage of dogfights where tight turns by fighter aircraft produced heated wingtips and twin vapor trails flying saucers were reported to do something similar a behavior that none of the later conventional explanations could adequately account for on january 16 1957 the day after nicaps board of governors met for the first time board chairman delmer s fahrney called a press conference news media across the country quoted his statements identifying him as one of the few members of the militarys top brass willing to speak publicly in defense of ufos as reported at the time retired rear adm delmer s fahrney once head of the navys guided missile program said wednesday reliable reports indicate that there are objects coming into our atmosphere at very high speeds fahrney told a news conference that no agency in this country or russia is able to duplicate at this time the speeds and accelerations which radar and observers indicate these flying objects are able to achieve fahrney told reporters that he had no information or preconceived ideas about whether the unidentified flying objects originated from outer space but he believed they involved a tremendous amount of technology of which we have no knowledge and that their development must have taken a very long time by 1957 the evidence for the existence of flying saucers was already quite strong if such a highperformance vehicle were based on earth and owned by one of the superpowers it should have appeared in some defense department inventory long ago it never did yet throughout the period when discs were being reported the disc shape itself was consistently dismissed it was said to be unrealistic incapable of flight that attitude began to change during the 1960s and 1970s over the years i have maintained a small file of statements by scientists and engineers concerning the use of a saucer shape for space travel and for flight within earths atmosphere in 1990 a particularly interesting article appeared in the aprilmay issue of science digest titled planet of origin hollywood by dennis meredith adapted from air space magazine according to engineers at mcdonnell douglas aerospace some of the spacecraft designs used in motion pictures were actually plausible several members of the companys spacestation design team analyzed three of the most famous spacecraft from the movies 1 2001s discovery 2 star treks enterprise 3 star wars millennium falcon before going deeper into disc performance it is worth briefly mentioning some other statements that are relevant to ufos according to merediths article the general consensus was that the writers of these films were scientifically timid in some respects and accurate in others the supercomputer hal from 2001 was considered far too large according to robert wood director of advanced systems and technology for the space station program in fact wood found all three movies to be overly conservative in their depictions of computers and optical systems based on the trends he had observed wood stated that within another hundred years optical computers in which calculations are performed using light would be almost magical in their power and compactness this raises an interesting point regarding reports of close encounters in which humans claim to remember being onboard a craft if the descriptions involve extremely advanced and unfamiliar technology the account might be genuine if on the other hand the equipment sounds too similar to presentday high technology the story may be either a fabrication or an honest but imagined experience regarding the supposed barriers to extraterrestrial travel to earth fritz runge mcdonnell douglas manager of user integration and commercialization along with other experts questioned whether surpassing the speed of light is truly impossible he suggested it might be analogous to breaking the sound barrier the faster one goes the greater the resistance and difficulty until the barrier is broken after which travel becomes easier when rating the three hollywood spacecraft additional interesting observations emerged the discovery from 2001 was criticized for lacking scanning devices to detect objects ahead and for carrying impressive rocket boosters that would be unnecessary in space nevertheless it was noted that the craft would make an excellent warship as george king a specialist in spacecraft configuration design explained a warship benefits from having the smallest possible radar cross section from the front or rear making a cylindrical or hotdog shape ideal notably cigar or torpedoshaped ufos were mentioned in the air force project sign report and have been reported many times the large carrierclass ufos are generally described as giant cigarshaped or rectangular craft perhaps the most interesting part of the article was mentioned last wood expressed appreciation for the ufolike contours of the millennium falcon he noted that a saucer shape provides a favorable lifttodrag ratio for aerodynamic maneuvering according to wood the falcon reflected a mcdonnell douglas study showing that a flying saucer would be ideal for maneuvering within earths atmosphere wood himself led that project which investigated propulsion schemes capable of exploiting earths magnetic field his team calculated that a gigantic saucer encircled laterally by a band of superconducting material could hold an enormous electric charge they concluded that such a craft could effectively float within earths magnetic and electric fields the air force project grudge report of december 1949 concluded based on actual military intelligence reports that ufos fell into three basic categories 1 the most numerous reports indicated daytime observations of metallic disclike objects with a diameter roughly ten times their thickness 2 rocketlike objects 3 sharply defined luminous objects appearing as lights at night other shapes were reported more rarely during the first few decades but became increasingly common in the 1980s and 1990s these included vshaped or boomerang objects triangular craft that were sometimes black with running lights and objects described as stingraylike futuristic or stealthlooking returning to the disc shape several years ago i conducted experiments that provided useful insights into ufo propulsion and many reported maneuvers a nineinch plastic disc flat on both the top and bottom and approximately threeeighths of an inch thick was tested in a swimming pool eight and a half feet deep water effectively simulated airflow and resistance when the disc was moved underwater by hand along its horizontal plane it maneuvered extremely well however when the disc was tilted out of its normal plane resistance increased dramatically sometimes feeling like a brick wall depending on the angle abrupt turns proved to be the easiest and most dramatic maneuvers by continuing the force at the aft end of the disc it was possible to produce either a rightangle turn or a tight uturn because the disc functioned as an omnidirectional wing it could move in any direction without requiring the crew compartment to rotate as long as force was applied within the crafts plane of movement resistance remained minimal regardless of whether that plane was level or angled relative to gravity if the disc was vertical it could still move forward with little resistance though gravity would pull it downward into a turn rather than allowing perfectly straight motion in another test the model was dropped vertically into the water without any additional force it was unable to descend in a perfectly vertical path and was immediately deflected during these tests the disc exhibited a pendulumlike or falling leaf motion as it arched into a curve and slowed it briefly hovered then reversed direction in a slightly lower arc this motion repeated in everwidening arcs until the disc settled on the bottom of the pool in a configuration resembling a classic ufo landing when the disc was nearly level and stationary it hovered because the line of maximum resistance was directly beneath it the resistance felt substantial almost as if the water had the consistency of gelatin the disc appeared weightless and would not move downward even when touched when pushed forward however it slid effortlessly until a turn was initiated as the turn angle increased resistance to forward motion grew so strong that the disc naturally avoided the undesired direction and glided smoothly in the chosen one these unusual effects were observed during every maneuver except the vertical drop test the disc configuration also offers practical advantages as a vehicle a large craft built in this manner could have its bridge sickbay security cafeteria and other pieshaped compartments directly accessible from a central entrance only a few feet away if large enough the entrance could function as an elevator to other levels all opening beneath the craft smaller scout ships commonly described in abduction reports appear to be simpler versions of the disc design as for nondisc sightings some observers suggest that these objects represent new stealth aircraft derived from ufo technology the available data however points toward a different possibility perhaps a covert trojan horse operation by a group possessing superior technology while a small percentage of reports may involve genuine humanbuilt stealth craft most credible witnesses describe nearly silent hovering vehicles or craft traveling at speeds below 100 miles per hour flying saucers or flying discs predominated during the first thirty years of the ufo era and were undoubtedly the basic units involved in its earliest phases from the very beginning some uninformed skeptics demanded more proof if these things are real somebody would have taken a picture by now when photographs finally appeared many of them clearly showing discshaped objects those same skeptics demanded even more proof when the air force came into possession of two topsecret ufo films in 1950 and 1952 that still was not enough even earlier at the dawn of the ufo era some argued that if these objects were real they should show up on radar that too seemed like a lost cause at the time despite the fact that there were already two official radar reports from 1945 one near okinawa using ground radar and another near the hanford nuclear plant in washington involving ground radar and visual confirmation by 1948 there were already five solid radar cases on record most ufos however did not appear on radar and skeptics seized on this as supposed proof that ufos could not exist in hindsight this is both interesting and ironic at the time none of us could have known that stealth technology would become possible so early and would eventually explain this apparent anomaly from the outset ufo technology appears to have centered on a highly efficient disc design that produces little or no noise is capable of extreme maneuverability at high speeds and seems to possess inherent stealth characteristics winged and boomerangshaped ufos on the other hand are often reported traveling very slowly and at low altitudes almost as if deliberately inviting observation though at times they also perform fast straightline speed runs ufos seem to be detected visually or on radar only when they choose to be or possibly when certain actions such as abrupt maneuvers momentarily give them away during the 1980s and early 1990s there was widespread discussion about crashed saucers and the emergence of stealth technology within human aerospace development to some the idea that winged craft were derived from ufo technology sounded plausible but many disagreed it makes little sense that a civilization or group operating perfected highperformance discshaped vehicles would abandon them in favor of winged designs thirty or forty years later unless this represented a deliberate attempt to mimic conventional aircraft for deception or unless the mission profile required a different type of vehicle it is also possible that the ufo operation entered a new phase with occupants piloting less sophisticated craft during the gulf war two of my sons were in the military and the experience prompted considerable reflection at the beginning of the conflict massive aircraft carriers highperformance jets and sea and airlaunched cruise missiles dominated the theater after the war ended coalition forces maintained peace but most of the heavy hardware was withdrawn the highperformance systems returned to base and the region was monitored using more distant and less sophisticated surveillance platforms this leads to pure speculation on my part suppose that the original extraterrestrial strike teams involved in the early phases of the ufo phenomenon around 1947 were later replaced by the 1990s with a coalition force operating less advanced vehicles in such a scenario the highperformance flying discs and their carrier craft may have been largely phased out as for the genuinely winged class of ufos their significance should not be dismissed there was a dramatic increase in reports of these objects during the 1990s and not all of them can be explained as misidentified aircraft i have personally witnessed several examples of this category which i classify as category 9 objects simply by being on call to approximately 95 percent of the population these objects would easily pass as conventional aircraft yet there remains a troubling inconsistency a quantum leap in technology surfaced roughly half a century ago which if displayed today in the same form as during its early phases appears either to have severely degraded or to have been replaced by something vastly inferior it makes little sense it is as if someone wrote a story about evolution and mixed up the chapters one thing is certain the basic disc design is not a lost cause despite decades of criticism from skeptics when flying saucer sightings first appeared in print most aeronautical engineers considered the reported performance impossible experts publicly stated that discshaped airfoils were inefficient unstable and difficult to control as ufo reports improved in quality and refused to disappear engineering opinions began to change in 1960 martin gerloff an aerodynamics expert at general electric offered a very different assessment of the disc the discus shape has equally good ability to operate in dense air rarefied regions and in empty space the discus shape is superior to all rotatingwing designs such as helicopters in vertical takeoff climb and cruising between the 17mile altitude of todays jets and the 200mile orbits of earthcircling satellites there exists an uncovered region the discus is extremely capable of flying in this rarefied area the discus planform has a bluntnose radius and an extended leading edge that alleviate local heating is it not strange that disc performance considered impossible in the 1940s and 1950s is now regarded as not only feasible with presentday technology but actively recommended by companies such as mcdonnell douglas one by one the arguments against the reality of ufos and discshaped craft are falling away after more than fifty years we still do not possess a true flying saucer some insist that any modern highperformance vehicle must have wings and noisy jet engines as the little girl in et said give me a break if flying saucers were real and operating in our atmosphere people would see them occasionally some of those witnesses would be credible and articulate occasionally someone would have both the presence of mind and a loaded camera to record one rarely but inevitably someone would capture motion picture footage from the very beginning they should also have appeared on radar strange as it may seem all of these things have already happened and since ufos do not require lights and usually operate in stealth mode the real question becomes why do they allow us to glimpse them at all while preparing the final draft of this paper i asked richard hall author of nicaps the ufo evidence to comment on it his response surprised me actually there have been quite a few more radar cases in the past thirty years than you might realize and many dozens of disc sightings as the ufo evidence ii will make clear i would not have known this except for a thorough review of the world literature because the missing factor is realtime news transmission compared to the old days but when you pull together sightings from all over the world i guarantee that many people will be surprised by how strong and consistent the patterns are your thesis about ufos going covert is defensible especially in the context of abductions and the reduction in cei and ceii sightings at least those that receive publicity there does appear to have been a scaling back of that type of activity but it has not disappeared entirely overall a great deal of strong evidence has been quietly accumulating and ueii is going to raise some eyebrows i can hardly wait finally as we approach the year 2000 something curious appears to be happening flying discs are back in the news references 1 francis ridge 2 science digest aprilmay 1990 by dennis meredith 3 ufology 1973 james mccampbell 4 the project grudge report 1949 usaf 5 night siege 1987 the hudson valley sightings imbrogno and hynek 6 the ufo investigator vol ii no 9 juneseptember 1963 7 aerospace engineering january 1960 martin gerloff 8 the trent photos

window just like i see in movies i take my jacket and wrap it around my arm using it to clear the broken glass i quietly step in before saying oh yeah im alone and a little dumb i rummage around the front door looking for a key bowl or key hooks finding nothing i start frantically looking around checking counters and drawers i found the hide and seek car keys on the ground in the hallway upstairs challenging the frame after receiving my cat result at the start of 2021 i appeared for several interviews at different bschools where i had applied during one of the interviews i told the panelists that i had been teaching positive mindset and interpersonal skills at an ngo who is the father of positive psychology one panelist asked me i had no idea whom she was talking about and i conveyed that to her how can you teach these things if you dont even know who is the father of positive psychology she remarked there it was the frame the frame is a set of beliefs and assumptions over which one person thinks the conversation should operate here the assumption was that one needs to know the father of positive psychology to teach that at an ngo i didnt defend my lack of knowledge about this static fact and neither did i tell her that id find out the answer after the interview i simply asked her even if i know this what difference will it make in my life or that of my students she immediately changed the topic for next question before you jump on to defend yourself in any discussion debate or even an argument first question the frame in which the other person is operating otherwise youll always put yourself in a weak spot because youve accepted their beliefs and assumptions and no amount of defense will be enough to change that consider this an employee might say she wants 20 raise but the manager points out that shes only been in the company for a year thats the frame he wants to operate in but then she asks him to discuss the impact of her contributions rather are we at a crossroads the automotive industrys great u turn after years of relentless technological change manufacturers are backtracking at remarkable speed buttons are returning combustion engines are getting lifelines and the eu just blinked on its total ice ban perhaps we were never ready for that scifi future after all you can feel it building that quiet but unmistakable sense that something has shifted in the automotive world not with a bang but through a series of revealing admissions and policy reversals that suggest the industry charged ahead without properly checking if anyone was actually following the european union has abandoned its outright ban on combustion engines replacing the 100 percent zero emission target for 2035 with a 90 percent fleet reduction requirement instead technology neutrality theyre calling it now a concession to efuels and synthetic options or to put it more plainly an acknowledgment that the original plan was never going to work porsche having committed billions to electrification is now reconsidering internal combustion options for models originally planned as evs only including a potential new ice powered macan this from a company that spent the past few years positioning itself as an electric pioneer the reality check came when taycan sales plummeted 49 percent in 2024 moving just over 20000 units compared to the previous year when your flagship ev takes that kind of hit you reassess and porsche is hardly alone in this pivot the entire volkswagen group appears to be hedging its bets extending ice and hybrid powertrains well into the 2030s for the cayenne and panamera even the next generation 718 models once destined to be purely electric may get combustion options for high end specifications these arent minor tweaks to a product plan theyre fundamental strategic reversals happening at unprecedented speed then there are the touchscreens remember when burying every function three menus deep on an ipad sized display was supposed to represent progress volkswagen design chief andreas mindt told autocar the company would never ever make this mistake any more referring to their over reliance on touch controls thats quite the admission mercedes hyundai and porsche have all announced plans to restore physical buttons and knobs to their cabins responding to what theyre now calling screen fatigue studies show touchscreen systems can distract drivers for an average of 40 seconds when programming navigation or adjusting settings during which a car traveling at 50mph covers half a mile the european new car assessment program has taken the remarkable step of announcing that from january 2026 five star safety ratings will require physical controls for critical functions like turn signals wipers and hazard lights theyre effectively penalizing the very design trend the industry spent years embracing the driver assistance systems present a more complicated picture since july 2024 all new cars sold in the eu must include intelligent speed assistance autonomous emergency braking lane keeping systems and drowsiness detection these features automatically reactivate every time you restart the vehicle as mandated by regulation theyre designed to save lives and the european commission projects theyll prevent more than 25000 deaths by 2038 but implementation matters enormously some drivers perceive adas features as being annoying or distracting prompting them to switch them off lane keep assist that yanks the wheel on country roads speed limiters that misread signs and try to slow you from 70 to 30mph on the motorway systems that beep vibrate and flash warnings with such frequency that you tune them out entirely the gap between theoretical safety benefits and real world usability remains vast what ties all of this together a growing sense that the automotive industry got swept up in its own vision of the future without pausing to consider whether customers actually wanted that future or at least wanted it on that timeline electric vehicles were mandated before charging infrastructure could support them touchscreens replaced buttons because they looked futuristic and saved manufacturing costs not because they improved the driving experience safety systems were legislated into existence with insufficient attention to how intrusive poorly calibrated versions would feel the backlash was inevitable a survey of 2000 britons found that 52 percent believe the 2035 ev target will not be met with 59 percent planning to keep their combustion vehicles on the road as long as possible thats not climate denial or technophobia thats pragmatism from people whove looked at the current state of ev technology charging networks and vehicle prices and decided the transition isnt ready for prime time consider the speed of these reversals the eus original ice ban was adopted just two years ago in march 2023 porsches electric macan launched in 2024 yet theyre already discussing a combustion successor volkswagen championed touchscreen interiors across its id range then reversed course within a product cycle these arent the measured adjustments of a maturing industry theyre course corrections happening in real time because the original direction proved untenable the phrase technology neutrality keeps appearing in these discussions typically as justification for walking back earlier commitments but its really code for something simpler we pushed too hard too fast and now were pulling back efuels and synthetic options provide political cover for keeping combustion engines around longer physical buttons are being marketed as premium features when theyre simply what worked all along extended ice timelines are framed as customer choice when theyre really about survival theres something almost admirable about how quickly the industry has pivoted no lengthy strategic reviews or five year transition plans just rapid acknowledgment that the previous approach wasnt working and immediate changes to product portfolios whether thats reactive crisis management or genuine responsiveness to market feedback probably depends on your perspective whats clear is that were witnessing a fundamental recalibration of what car buyers actually want versus what they were told they should want turns out people quite like knowing where the climate control button is without looking they appreciate combustion engines that can be refueled in five minutes anywhere in the country they want safety systems that feel helpful rather than hectoring none of this should be surprising yet somehow it caught an entire industry off guard the scifi future of silent electric pods with gesture controls and hands free driving may still arrive eventually but not in 2030 or 2035 as originally promised the grand vision collided with practical reality and reality won manufacturers are now rebuilding their strategies around what customers demonstrate they want through purchasing decisions rather than what focus groups said they might want someday perhaps thats what a genuine crossroads looks like not a dramatic fork in the road but a series of small reversals that collectively represent a major change in direction the automotive world spent years accelerating toward a specific vision of the future now its pumping the brakes and asking whether that destination was ever realistic in the first place based on everything happening right now the answer appears to be no

miliband stands alone as brussels drops the 2035 petrol ban the eu has abandoned its plan to eliminate combustion engines by 2035 leaving britains energy secretary defending an even tighter deadline with no major ally in sight manfred weber president of the european peoples party confirmed that the eus 100 percent emissions reduction target for 2035 has been replaced with a 90 percent requirement weber told german newspaper bild that the technology ban on combustion engines is now off the table meaning all engines currently manufactured in germany can continue to be produced and sold the announcement followed months of lobbying by german car makers who were most agitated about the prospect of a combustion engine ban alongside pressure from italy poland slovakia hungary czech republic and bulgaria ed miliband now finds himself defending britains 2030 ban on new petrol and diesel vehicles five years ahead of what the eu was planning with no major trading partner willing to go as far the dramatic reversal across the channel will be seen as a fresh blow to miliband and labours net zero policies that critics say risk damaging industry and driving up costs for households the uks position is more aggressive than the abandoned eu plan britain confirmed its 2030 phase out date for new petrol and diesel car sales with hybrids to be sold until 2035 labour reinstated the 2030 deadline after rishi sunak pushed it back to 2035 arguing it would provide industry certainty that certainty now looks like isolation with britain moving faster than the entire european bloc while manufacturers struggle to meet existing targets electric vehicles accounted for just 196 percent of the uk market in 2024 with november being the only month to reach the 22 percent market share set by the governments zero emission vehicle mandate the zev mandate requires 28 percent of sales to be zero emission vehicles in 2025 targets that increase annually until the 2030 ban manufacturers missing these targets face fines creating constant tension between government policy and market reality andy palmer former chief executive of aston martin warned that the uk would have to follow the eus lead because of the high number of vehicles traded between the two areas arguing that if the eu drops their ban factories there wont ramp up ev production in the way forecast robert forrester chief executive of top car dealership chain vertu said the european reversal made the eu appear more pragmatic and flexible than the uk shadow net zero secretary claire coutinho argued the government should back consumer choice rather than force people into electric cars industry groups echoed the concern sigrid de vries head of europes automotive trade body acea said the original 2035 target is no longer realistic given the lack of charging infrastructure inconsistent incentives and falling competitiveness especially as china continues to flood the market with low cost evs the governments response has been defiant a uk government spokesman said the government remains committed to phasing out all new non zero emission car and van sales by 2035 noting that november saw another month of increased sales with evs accounting for one in four cars sold a review has been pencilled in for 2027 though that feels like kicking the problem down the road rather than addressing it environmental groups reacted angrily to the eus climbdown with colin walker head of transport at the energy and climate intelligence unit saying weakening the rules would keep european households stuck driving dirtier and more expensive petrol cars for longer but manufacturers see it differently volvo and polestar criticised calls to soften the ban warning that policy uncertainty could hand an advantage to chinese electric vehicle makers that are already scaling rapidly britain is now the most aggressive major economy on combustion engine phase out moving faster than the eu while facing the same challenges around consumer demand charging infrastructure and chinese competition miliband can frame this as climate leadership or as being left holding a policy the rest of europe has abandoned either way manufacturers are watching brussels more closely than westminster and that should worry everyone involved

center differential are required before the first run of the vehicle reason the plastic bearing adapter that comes preinstalled will melt from the heat of the slipper clutch which will cause the bearing to seize trust me it happened to me only took about 2 packs before it seized i highly recommend that you do not run your vehicle until you replace the plastic bearing adapter not even once steering returncentering its not you the steering return is abysmal out of the box root cause combination of plastic steering bushings anemic stock steering servo and sloppy factory bellcrank system especially the servo saver solution that finally worked replace plastic bell crank with aluminum be sure to leverage the adjustable servo saver replace bearings with bushings bushings with bearings replace steering servo sway bars buyers note traxxas has moved to including the extreme heavy duty upgrade kit as standard on the traxxas rally st models even the bl2s the one drawback to the ehd kit is the fact that the shock towers interfere with the sway bars in order to get full range of motion out of my sway bars i had to take a rotary tool to my shock towers i do not know if the various aluminum shock towers out there have clearance for the sway bars or not if someone can confirm in the comments ill update this bullet point i like to run my rally everywhere so imho the sway bars are worth it i went with a thirdparty option but the traxxas sway bars have a generally positive sentiment among the community if you go with a third party sway bar option bear in mind that the included hardware is garbage specifically im referring to the sets that come with those 2piece counter sunk screw washer combos as the installation hardware throw these things away you can still use thirdparty cover if you are a racer you can skip this section though you might be interested in how the scorched fenders affect the vehicles ability to jump imho this is not optional because of the interaction between the 4 wheel nature of the vehicle and the shape of the body the front wheels roost dirtdebris straight up into the body the shape of which direct it straight into the chassis you will have a chassis caked with dirt sand mud whatever substrate you are running expect your chassis to fill with it the inner fenders and chassis cover both solve this problem but in different ways fender guards pros better overall protection improves vehicles ability to jump yes really when trimmed correctly the fender guards fill in the side skirts of the body which prevents the inherent parachuting issue the model has from the factory fender guards neutral requires 2 holes to be drilled on each side of the model fender guards cons makes tuning the model more difficult clever trimming of the guards can help but itll never be as easy to tune your model with these installed as it is without them installed takes more time to remove than the dust cover requiring 8 screws to be removed chassis cover pros large debris out of the chassis chassis cover cons allows some small dust particles into the chassis but overall does a good job of preventing it from caking the chassis while effective at preventing debris from loitering in the chassis it does not prevent the initial impact large enough debris leaving the tires at high enough speed can damage electrical components even while the bag is installed
